plan: With a private value of $18, my goal is to maximize potential profit. Since this is a first-price sealed bid auction where I pay the second-highest bid, I want to bid strategically. A pure optimal strategy is to bid slightly less than my full value to capture maximum surplus. I'll aim to bid around $16-17, which gives me potential profit if others bid lower, while still likely winning the auction.

My value is $15. To maximize profit, I want to win only if I can do so with a low bid relative to my value. Since values are drawn independently and randomly, I'll aim to bid just above the expected second-highest bid. Given the $0-$20 range, I'll bid around $10-$12 to create a good chance of winning while preserving significant profit margin if I win.

With a private value of $35, I want to maximize my potential profit. Since the prize is drawn between $0-$20, my high value suggests I should bid aggressively. However, I want to bid just enough to win without overpaying. A smart strategy is to bid near the upper range of the expected prize value, around $19-$20, which gives me the best chance of winning while minimizing my payment.
